title: Reserve Runway Trigger Stitchbook
summary: Compact 12-month capacity / price trigger workbook that stitches together committed vs spot GPU allocation, hiring funnel phasing, and three price-shock sensitivity scenarios. Designed as a lightweight runbook for finance + ops to flip switches when token unit price or spot supply shifts. Contains month-by-month cash impact table, HC gating rules, and recommended automated triggers tied to billing metrics.
assumptions: Base revenue growth: 18% CAGR over next 12 months (conservative funnel conversion)
Token mix: 70% generation tokens / 30% embedding tokens; average token price contribution based on current list rates
Committed capacity: reserved GPU pool (p3/p4 mix) priced at blended $/hr with 30% discount vs on-demand
Spot capacity volatility: expected +/‑ 40% price swing in adverse market weeks
Hiring ramp: hiring lead time 8–10 weeks for infra/ops, 6–8 weeks for junior finance roles
Quantization & batching savings: incremental 6% unit cost improvement phased in month 3
month_table: Month,Committed GPU hrs,Spot GPU hrs,Blended token rate ($/k-token),Estimated revenue ($k),OpEx (ex-HC) ($k),HC plan (FTEs total),New FTEs added,Committed $/mo ($k),Spot $/mo ($k),Net burn delta ($k)
scenarios: Base: current price environment; quantization savings phased in month 3; hiring as planned (adds listed in month_table). Outcome: net burn turns positive (improving) by month 6.

Downside (spot spike & demand dip): spot cost +40%, revenue growth stalls to 6% over 3 months. Immediate response: throttle burst/spot to 30% of baseline, freeze non-critical hiring. Cash impact modelled as additional $210k burn in first 2 months; runway contraction 6 weeks.

Upside (price tailwind): spot cost -20%, revenue growth accelerates to 25% CAGR; opportunity: accelerate HC for product and capture market. Cash improves by $180k/mo; recommend convert 25% of planned hires to earlier start dates and increase committed coverage to lock savings.
trigger_rules: Spot price > baseline * 1.25 for 7-day moving avg -> auto-shrink spot allocation by 30% and route to committed or lower-cost regions
Effective token unit cost (realized) > forecast by 12% for 10-day MA -> pause non-essential feature launches and defer 50% of planned hiring for next sprint
Monthly revenue delta < -8% MoM -> enable temporary pricing promo pause and open emergency hiring freeze board (Finance + CEO sign-off)
Committed utilization < 55% for 21 days -> investigate overcommit + reallocate to marketplace or shorten next reserve tranche
recommended_actions: Implement billing watch: instrument token-level realized $/k-token in BigQuery with 24h alerting to FinOps channel (JIRA:FIN-947)
Add one-shot Lambda to automatically scale spot pool down when spot MA trigger is hit; ops runbook in confluence: FIN-RUNWAY-382
Create hiring gating doc for infra/ops roles: every FTE addition post month 3 requires projected 3-month payback at base-case pricing
Run tabletop in next exec meeting: downside scenario run (spot +40% & demand stall) and validate operational playbook
Negotiate flexible reserve options with cloud vendors to allow mid-term tranche rebalancing (goal: reduce penalty window from 90 -> 30 days)
